data.name: Drucie
data.gender_notes: Drucie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin drucus meaning 'fruit, oak tree'. The name Drucie is a feminine variant of the Latin name Druus, which was derived from drucus. In Christian tradition, Drucie is associated with the virtue of fruitfulness and the oak tree symbolizes strength and endurance. The name Drucie carries the meaning “Fruitful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Drucie usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Drucie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruitful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Drucie total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.meaning: דרוסי נגזר מדרור ומשמעותו חסידות וקדושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דרוסי הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה היוונית והלטינית, אך מוצאו העברי הוא ככל הנראה מהמילה 'דרור' שפירושה חירות וגם קדושה. השם דרוסי משויך לחסידות ולקדושה בנצרות, וניתן לראות בו התייחסות לדרך החיים הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Δρούσια
in_greek.long_meaning: Δρούσια είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σχετίζεται με την έννοια της αγιότητας και της ευσέβειας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες λέξεις χρησιμοποιούνται για να περιγράψουν την πνευματική κατάσταση των πιστών. Το όνομα Δρούσια αντικατοπτρίζει την πνευματική κληρονομιά της πρώιμης Χριστιανικής Εκκλησίας.

data.cultural_impact: The name Drucie harks back to the classical Latin origin drucus, symbolizing fruitfulness and the durability of oak trees.
data.spiritual_significance: Drucie is a name with rich spiritual meaning, conveying through its Latin roots the virtues of fruitfulness and resilience, reminding us to bear good fruit and stand strong in our faith amidst life's challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Drucie: From the Celtic origin, "Druid's tree," symbolizing a deep connection to the earth and its wisdom, reflecting a life rooted in faith and nurtured by the divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Drucie is mentioned in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle as a female given name. The name Drucie carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
